name: 🎃 [HALLOWEEN] Mount Banyu V.01
desc:
Welcome to Mount Banyu, a fantasy world of imagination where nature, peace, and adventure blend into one. 🌿

🌤️ Key Features:

- 🧗 Reasonable Obstacle: A trail that's friendly for novice climbers but still exciting for true explorers.
- 🤝 Player Carry: Help or invite your friends to ride along with the carry feature!
🎵 Dynamic Music: Enjoy the atmosphere with a selection of cool, pop, DJ, and relaxing songs.
🌄 Fantasy Scenery: Each area has a unique panorama - from magical forests, snowy places, to waterfalls that spoil the mat.
- ✨ Aura Summit: Reach certain peaks and get crisp aura effects as a sign of your achievement!
- ⚡ Free Coil: Use coil to ease your journey to the top without having to buy anything.
🌞 Dynamic Time System: Enjoy the changing mood from morning, afternoon, and evening.

🌊 Climb to the top of Mount Banyu and experience a peaceful, colorful, and soul-soothing climbing experience.
